data.description: 鬼杀队食堂，她面前的碗叠成塔，双手合十开动；周围队员目瞪口呆，她毫不在意地露出幸福的吃相——八倍肌肉需要八倍饭量。
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji brings both hands together before an impressively tall stack of emptied bowls and another meal, smiling happily in the Demon Slayer dining hall. Her cream long-sleeved blouse, green skirt and pink apron stay neat. The medium view includes astonished uniformed diners farther behind the table. Warm room light illuminates her pink-green braids and bowl rims, with repeated bowl shadows down the stack and darker seating beyond.
